title: Sample: Monthly reporting, automated
summary: A template project showing how a finished project reads. Edit or delete it once you have added your own.
businessCase:
Finance spent two days every month copying figures from three systems into one report.

The goal was to cut that to minutes and remove copy-and-paste errors.

- Who needed it: the finance team
- Decision it supports: monthly budget review
findings:
## Result

The report now builds itself in under five minutes.

- Manual effort fell from two days to minutes
- Three recurring data errors were found and fixed at source
